name: avatarmcp
description: MCP server for managing and animating VRM avatars with support for animations, expressions, and real-time control
author: Sandra Schi

prompts.name: load_avatar_prompt
prompts.template: Load the avatar from {path} and name it {name}.

prompts.name: play_animation_prompt
prompts.description: Play an animation on an avatar
prompts.template: Play the {animation_name} animation on {avatar_name} with {speed}x speed.

prompts.name: set_expression_prompt
prompts.description: Set a facial expression on an avatar
prompts.template: Set the {expression_name} expression on {avatar_name} with {intensity}% intensity.

prompts.name: move_avatar_prompt
prompts.description: Move an avatar to a new position

prompts.name: export_avatar_prompt
prompts.description: Export an avatar to a file
